mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, the temperature is 38 degrees with foggy conditions at Verona City Hall, all under the light of a waxing gibbous moon.

The City of Verona is working on a space needs evaluation for the Public Works and Utilities facility to accommodate population growth, and reconstruction work continues on Mark Drive with phase two underway.
We have plenty to look forward to, including live music at Bailey's Run today and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, plus yoga at Insight Wellness on November 23.
Regarding recent activity, on November 2, officers were dispatched to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old Verona man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, which is Really Reese's, and remember that the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
